mapper.update: /*LGVATT00016.mergeAnnualLeave*/ MERGE INTO tb_att_emp_annual_m a USING dual b ON (a.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND a.effective_start_date = to_date(#{effectiveStartDate}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET emp_type = #{empType} ,annual_leave_days = #{annualLeaveDays} ,effective_end_date = to_date(#{effectiveEndDate}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') ,last_update_user_id = #{applicationUserId} ,last_update_date = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (employee_no ,effective_start_date ,effective_end_date ,emp_type ,annual_leave_days ,creation_user_id ,creation_date ,last_update_user_id ,last_update_date) VALUES (#{employeeNo} ,to_date(#{effectiveStartDate}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') ,to_date(#{effectiveEndDate}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') ,#{empType} ,#{annualLeaveDays} ,#{applicationUserId} ,SYSDATE ,#{applicationUserId} ,SYSDATE)

/*LGVATT00016.recalculateAnnualLeave*/ UPDATE tb_att_emp_annual_m ann SET annual_leave_days = GREATEST(0, LEAST(4, CEIL((MONTHS_BETWEEN( CASE WHEN (SELECT em.date_retire FROM emp_master em WHERE em.employee_number = ann.employee_no) IS NOT NULL THEN LEAST((SELECT em.date_retire FROM emp_master em WHERE em.employee_number = ann.employee_no), ann.effective_end_date) ELSE ann.effective_end_date END ,ann.effective_start_date) / 12 * (CASE WHEN ann.emp_type = '4' THEN 2 ELSE 4 END)) * 2) / 2)) ,last_update_user_id = #{applicationUserId} ,last_update_date = SYSDATE WHERE ann.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND ann.effective_start_date = to_date(#{effectiveStartDate}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AND ann.annual_leave_days IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT /*LGVATT00016.retrieveEmpTypeNameList*/ lcm.common_code as code, lcm.common_code_name as name FROM lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c lcm ,lgcom_common_code_c lcc WHERE lcm.code_type_code = 'LGVHR_AL_EMP_TYPE_CODE' AND lcm.code_type_code = lcc.code_type_code AND lcm.common_code = lcc.common_code AND lcm.language_code = #{languageCode} -- session language AND lcc.use_flag = 'Y'
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO TB_ATT_EMP_ANNUAL_M (EMPLOYEE_NO, EMP_TYPE, EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, CREATION_USER_ID, CREATION_DATE) select trim(li.attribute1) employee_no ,trim(li.attribute2) emp_type ,TO_DATE(trim(li.attribute3), 'DD/MM/YYYY') effective_start_date ,TO_DATE(trim(li.attribute4), 'DD/MM/YYYY') effective_end_date ,#{applicationUserId} AS CREATION_USER_ID ,SYSDATE
from lgcom_import_n li
where li.session_id = #{sessionId}
and li.seq_no > 1
and not exists (select 'Y'
from tb_att_emp_annual_m ea
where ea.employee_no = trim(li.attribute1) and ea.effective_start_date = TO_DATE(trim(li.attribute3), 'DD/MM/YYYY') )
